title: Protection Claim Work on Bench Work Orders
content:
# Workshop and Protection Desk Liaison Note: Claim Work on Bench Work Orders

This note records how a protection plan meets a bench bill on the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, and which of this policy's conditions still stand.

## Conditions in force

**Levels that admit claim work.** Coverage is applied only at the service levels that admit protection work, and where the level does not admit it the piece is moved to a level that does before the work begins.

**What the coverage does not answer for.** Anything the coverage does not answer for stays on the work order as the customer's own balance, and the deductible under the plan is collected at the counter rather than netted off here.

## Conditions withdrawn from this policy

Three conditions of this policy are **no longer in force** and are recorded here so that no desk applies them:

- that work carried out under an accepted protection claim is taken off the work order rather than billed to the customer;
- that where no protection claim has been accepted the desk does not take the amount off in anticipation of one, because the claim decision is the protection desk's to make and not this one's;
- that coverage is applied only against the priced line it answers for, identified by the claim reference and the work order entry the claim was accepted for — together with the reading of the records that went with it, namely that the claim reference and the priced line the claim was accepted for were both to be found standing on the work order's own entries before the amount was taken off.

The circumstances in which an amount a claim answers for is taken off a work order, the figure it comes to and the priced line it is recorded against are settled on the current basis for credits taken off a bench work order under a protection claim.

## Point of judgement

A work order at Designer Authorized Repair Service, the one level of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service that does not admit protection work, is moved to a level that does before the work begins; the alternative of carrying out the work at that level and settling the coverage afterwards is not open.
